speaker_role: current admissions officers (University of Tampa graduate business programs)
commercial_incentive: promotes University of Tampa's own graduate/MBA programs throughout
key_insights: Covers 'secrets' aimed at MBA/graduate business applicants: first impressions, researching schools/accreditation, professional email etiquette, campus visits, and treating quantitative (GMAT/GPA) vs qualitative (resume/essay/recommendations/interview) materials differently.
States recommendation letters should come from people who know the applicant well rather than from high-status titles alone.
Notes GMAT/GRE and GPA minimums vary by school and that a lower GPA can be offset by an upward trend in the last 60 credit hours or strong qualitative materials.
Mentions GMAT waivers can exist for specific honor-society members meeting other criteria.
Advises keeping application materials for multiple schools strictly organized/separated to avoid mixing up submissions.
specific_numbers_or_facts: University of Tampa panelists said minimum GPA requirements 'can be three, 3.5' depending on the school
AACSB accreditation held by 'less than 5%' of business schools worldwide, per the panelists
